title: Thinner Every Time
logline: A potter throws a graduated set of bowls in one sitting, each wall thinner than the last, judging by feel alone the point where thinner would mean broken.
human_question: Is getting subtler the same as getting better, and how do you know you have gone as far as this material allows?

situation.what_happens: A potter works through a sequence in a single session, from the thickest vessel to the thinnest they can safely throw from the same clay. Each attempt is only possible because the previous one has been done often enough to be automatic, and the last one before failure is found by failing. Nothing is added as the sequence goes on; material is taken away.
situation.who_is_involved: A potter who works to order or for market; an apprentice or family member learning at a different pace; whoever buys the ware and decides what a fine wall is worth.
situation.what_is_at_stake: Wasted clay, wasted firing and a day's earnings, against the satisfaction and the price of work no one else locally can do. For an apprentice: being visibly slower than the person teaching them.
situation.how_it_unfolds: A session begins with centring and ends when the clay or the hands give out. Pressure comes from fatigue, from the clay drying, and from the knowledge that the interesting attempts are the ones most likely to collapse. Reality decides how far the potter actually gets that day, and whether the thinnest piece survives the kiln.

concept_merge.why_together: C088 (the higher absorptions) contributes the movement itself: each stage is reached only by seeing that the previous one, though good, is coarse beside it, and letting go of attachment to it, with the sources' own simile of four cloths of the same size woven from coarser to finer thread [C088-P4:L280–L284]. C014 (the immaterial minds) contributes the dependence, in its image of men hanging from a pavilion roof, each held by the one before [C014-P:L68]. C015 (immaterial resultant and functional minds) contributes the honest note that people move at different paces and the teaching itself was divided differently for them [C015-P:L45–L47].
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: Together they show refinement as subtraction resting on mastery, which is the opposite of how improvement is usually pictured. The cloth simile alone would be decorative; the nested dependence alone would be a diagram; the pace difference alone would risk ranking people. Held together they make a plain claim: deeper means less, each level has to be finished before it can look coarse, and nobody skips one.

concept_links.why: The source describes moving on only after seeing a factor as coarse compared with a calmer state and dropping attachment to it, and uses four cloths of equal size woven from coarser to finer thread as its own simile [C088-P4:L280–L284]. The digest warns that these states presuppose ethics and long training and are not a focus technique, and that nothing filmable shows them.

The Pradeepika's closing simile has men hanging from a pavilion roof, each supported by the one before [C014-P:L68], which is the same relation the nested vessels have physically. The digest also notes these states are still inside the round, not liberation, so the sequence is not a ladder out of anything.

The source says some people need fewer preparatory moments and some more, and that the same ground was divided into four steps for quicker learners and five for slower ones [C015-P:L45–L47]. The digest is explicit that this must not become a ranking of people's worth, so a master and an apprentice at different paces can be shown only as a difference in pace.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: In the texts, you go deeper by letting go rather than by adding more: each stage is mastered fully, and only then does it look rough beside something finer. Some people need more small steps than others, but no one skips a stage.
what_must_be_real: The potter's real practice, real judgement and real failures, including a day when the sequence does not work. The film never claims the craft is meditation or that anyone has attained anything.
position_hint: middle: it follows the film about long attention and sets up depth as subtraction before the group turns to insight and to the decisive change.
risks: Forcing the refinement reading onto ordinary variation in a working day
Romanticising a livelihood under real economic pressure
Letting a difference in pace between two people read as a ranking of them
drop_if: No potter works this way without being asked to perform a sequence for the camera
Attempting the sequence would cost the potter a day's income the film cannot honestly offset

connections.note: Two close studies of attention refining: one on a single object, one across a graduated sequence.
Refinement of depth here; sameness of destination with difference of texture there.

selection.reason: Used by EPD-0090; the cloth and pavilion similes are the sources' own images for the same movement.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
